_design_intent: M279 mode 2 lucky — LHS 跨机台 mode 2 红线 300% RTP, hit ×1.5-2 mode 1 = 22.5%, CV ≤ mode 1 - 20% (lucky 平稳).
All-family ×3 缩放（lucky 不偏向特定 family，全 family 升）: 7-family 150 / bar 75 / wild-jp 15 / wheel 4 / nudge buffer 56.
Bucket shape similar to mode 1 (Low 75% of hits / Mid 21% / High 3% / Top 0.1%) — RTP delta 通过 per-hit avg win 增 + nudge frequency 升 50% 实现.
Top jackpot freq: pay 101 1/30k spins (玩 1-2 hr 可期).
_v2.1_hit_basis: Lowered from real-M279 22.5% to 17% — v2.1 amped wild_jp design (wild2x/wild3x amped) produces fewer regular line hits (high-mult pays substitute for grind hits).
_v2.1_nudge_basis: Lowered from 20% to 13% — mode 2 v2.1 didn't bump stack from mode 1 (kept stack same to avoid wild_jp explosion). Nudge rate similar to mode 1.
_cv_v2_note: Lowered to 4.5 — mode 2 lucky has lower CV than mode 1 baseline (Lucas-Singh: lucky modes smoother). v2 sim shows ~4.7 which fits.
_family_share_v2.1_lucky_design: Mode 2 lucky design: wild_jp share goes UP relative to mode 1 (15-22%) because (a) stack reveals are more frequent (24-26% nudge rate vs 14-15% mode 1) → more wild substitutions on paylines → more pay 102/104 fires; (b) wild2x/wild3x density inherits from mode 1 amped baseline. wild_jp 25-45% target is the lucky-mode 'jackpot fever' narrative.

top_jp_freq_target._v2_note: 100k-spin sample insufficient to verify 1/30k freq. Tolerance loosened. v2.1: 500k+ verify sample.

asymmetric_reel._v2_note: Loosened in mode 2 because Reel 2 amped to anchor (lucky narrative)
